title: Point-counting trace formula
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum
$p,a,q,k_0,k$, where $q=p^a$, let $X_0$ be a
separated finite-type
$k_0$-scheme, put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, and let
$K=(\Qlb)_X$ be the constant
Weil sheaf with its canonical
Weil structure, the geometric Frobenius acting trivially. Assume
the compactification admissibility of
[thm-trf-grothendieck-lefschetz-qbar] for the constant lattice
$(\mathcal O_E)_X$ of $E_X$ at every finite level (the etale-origin
witnesses required there are supplied in the proof). Then for every
$m\geq1$,

$$
\#X_0(\mathbf F_{q^m})
=
\sum_{i\in\mathbf Z}(-1)^i
\operatorname{Tr}\bigl(F^m\mid H_c^i(X,\Qlb)\bigr),
$$

and, when $X_0$ is
proper,

$$
\#X_0(\mathbf F_{q^m})
=
\sum_{i\in\mathbf Z}(-1)^i
\operatorname{Tr}\bigl(F^m\mid H^i(X,\Qlb)\bigr),
$$

compactly supported cohomology being the ordinary one.

proof.text: Write $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ for the finite coefficient levels in the hypothesis. Take the completed constant lattice $K_{\mathcal O}=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}$ and its rationalization $K_E=E_X$. By [lem-weil-constant-coefficient-objects-constructible], $K_{\mathcal O}$ is constructible and derived complete, and its derived reductions are exactly $K_n=(A_n)_X[0]$. A reduction is a one-term free rank-one coefficient module, so it has Tor-amplitude $[0,0]$; constructibility is also given by that lemma. The canonical Weil maps $\theta_{\mathcal O}$ and $\theta_n$ of [def-weil-constant-weil-structure] commute with the reduction maps. The canonical isomorphisms $K_{n+1}\otimes^L_{A_{n+1}}A_n\cong K_n$ are the multiplication maps $A_{n+1}\otimes_{A_{n+1}}A_n\to A_n$ on these free models; thus the tower with its reduction transitions is normalized in [def-trf-adic-system]. The rationalization of $\theta_{\mathcal O}$ is the canonical $\theta_E$. By [lem-weil-constant-weil-structure-stage-independence], the pair $(E,(E_X,\theta_E))$ represents the specified constant $\Qlb$-Weil object $K$, even when the hypothesis uses a coefficient field larger than $\Ql$.

source.place: first sentence: the constant lattice and its finite reductions

proof.text: At each $n$, $K_n$ is locally constant on the single stratum $X$, with finite stalk module $A_n$, by [lem-weil-constant-coefficient-objects-constructible]. Apply clause (b) of [lem-sf-proetale-locally-constant-origin] with $\Lambda=A_n$, retaining a lisse etale sheaf $G_n$ and an isomorphism $\alpha_n:\nu_X^*G_n\xrightarrow{\sim}(A_n)_X$. Place $G_n$ and $\alpha_n$ in degree zero and retain the pair $(G_n[0],\alpha_n[0])$ as the etale-origin witness of [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. This supplies actual witness data at each level, rather than assuming an origin predicate. No compatibility between these witness choices is required by the statement of [thm-trf-grothendieck-lefschetz-qbar]; the compatible transition and Weil maps are those of the constant tower in Step 1. The other finite-level input of that theorem, compactification admissibility for this constant lattice, is exactly the hypothesis of the item. Therefore its finite-level assumptions all hold.

source.place: first two sentences: supplying the finite-level witnesses; Stacks Tag 099Y, proetale.tex label lemma-compare-locally-constant

proof.text:
Fix $m\geq1$ and $y\in X_0(\mathbf F_{q^m})$. For the constant tower take $u=\theta_{\mathcal O}$ and $N=0$ in [prop-trf-rational-frobenius-integral-model]. Its finite coefficient morphisms are $\psi_n=\theta_n\circ\kappa_{K_n}$ and their iterates are $\theta_n^{[m]}\circ\kappa^{(m)}_{K_n}$. These are the canonical maps on the pullback of the constant coefficient unit: under the canonical coefficient identifications, each factor sends the constant generator $1$ to $1$, and their composite does too. Thus [cor-trf-constant-stalk-trace], applied with $A=A_n$ and $h=\Phi^m$, gives trace $1\in A_n$ for each finite-level fixed-stalk operator. The normalization of the local operators in [prop-trf-rational-frobenius-integral-model] identifies these fixed-stalk maps with $\psi_{n,m,\bar y}$, and its integral operator $U_{y,m}$ reduces to them. Clauses (3) and (4) of [prop-trf-adic-coefficient-morphism-systems] then say that the trace of $U_{y,m}$ is the compatible family $(1\bmod\varpi_E^n)_n$, hence is $1\in\mathcal O_E$. By the local-operator formula in [prop-trf-rational-frobenius-integral-model] with $N=0$, $F_{y,m}$ at the $E$-stage is $U_{y,m}\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E$. Scalar extension along $\mathcal O_E\to E\to\Qlb$ and the field supertrace law in [prop-trf-trace-formal-laws] give
$$\sum_j(-1)^j\operatorname{Tr}(F_{y,m}\mid H^j(K_{\bar y}))=1\in\Qlb.$$
In particular, this passage uses the integral realization before rationalization; it does not use a nonexistent ring map $A_n\to E$.

source.place: local trace paragraph: unit trace at each finite level, followed through the integral and field stages

proof.text: Apply [thm-trf-grothendieck-lefschetz-qbar] to the representative of Step 1 and the hypotheses verified in Step 2. It gives the alternating compact-cohomology trace as the sum of the local supertraces of Step 3. Its statement also gives finite-dimensionality of all the vector spaces and boundedness of the cohomological degrees, so the alternating sums are finite. Its global operator is the $m$-th power of the compactly supported geometric Frobenius denoted $F$ in [def-weil-global-geometric-frobenius]: at finite level this identification is [lem-trf-frobenius-operator-compact-description], and [prop-trf-rational-frobenius-integral-model] identifies its integral realization and its rationalization with the specified field-stage operator (here $N=0$). Realization, rationalization and scalar extension preserve compositions and identities, so they preserve the equality with the $m$-fold composite. Finally [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology] identifies $H_c^i(X,K)$ with the notation $H_c^i(X,\Qlb)$ used in the conclusion.

source.place: conclusion of the local trace paragraph: applying the general trace formula

proof.text: The rational-point set $S=X_0(\mathbf F_{q^m})$ is finite by clause (1) of [lem-weil-point-counts-finite], applied to the finite extension $\mathbf F_{q^m}/k_0$. Substitute the local value $1$ from Step 3 into the finite sum in Step 4. Then $\sum_{y\in S}1=\#S$ (the natural number viewed in $\Qlb$), including when $S$ is empty. Reversing the resulting equality gives exactly the first displayed formula.

source.place: last part of the local trace paragraph: finiteness and summing the unit local terms

proof.text:
Suppose now that $X_0$ is proper. By [prop-weil-proper-compact-coincidence] there is the natural comparison $\kappa_M:Ra_{X!}M\xrightarrow{\sim}Ra_{X*}M$, giving $j_M=\operatorname{Fib}_s(\kappa_M):R\Gamma_c(X,M)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma(X,M)$. Use the identity compactification specified in [lem-pod-proper-coincidence-frobenius] for its $\operatorname{FrEx}_{X,!}$ and $\tau_{c,M}$. Clause (2) of [lem-pod-proper-coincidence-frobenius] gives $\tau_Mj_M=j_{Lg^*M}\tau_{c,M}$ at $\Lambda=\Qlb$. Write $M=\operatorname{For}K$ and $\theta:Lg^*M\to M$ for its Weil map. Naturality of $j$ gives $R\Gamma(\theta)j_{Lg^*M}=j_MR\Gamma_c(\theta)$. Multiply these two equalities to obtain
$$Fj_M=R\Gamma(\theta)\tau_Mj_M=j_MR\Gamma_c(\theta)\tau_{c,M},$$
where $F,F_c$ are the two operators of [def-weil-global-geometric-frobenius], evaluated stagewise for $\Qlb$. Inducting on $m$ gives $F^mj_M=j_MF_c^m$. Conjugacy invariance and the field supertrace law of [prop-trf-trace-formal-laws] therefore identify the alternating trace on $H_c^i(X,K)$ with that on $H^i(X,K)$. Replace the former by the first formula and use the abbreviations of [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology]. This proves the proper formula, including compatibility of the cohomology comparison with the Frobenius action.

source.place: final sentence: proper comparison, with its Frobenius equivariance made explicit

No statement change or new nodes.

The unit sk-thm-trace-transport route is retained.

Step 2: lisse witness pair G_n[0], alpha_n[0]; admissibility is the item's hypothesis, and thm-trf-trace-formula-e needs nothing else at finite level. Step 3: with N=0, psi_{n,m} is the canonical unit comparison for h=Phi^m (an endomorphism of A_X sending 1 to 1 is the canonical one); constant-stalk trace gives 1 in A_n; adic (2)-(4) give tr=1 in O_E; scalar extension and supertrace give 1 in Qbar; no map A_n to E is used. Step 4: thm-qbar plus integral-model m=1 identification give F_c=F. F^m=F_c^m is only sketched ('functors preserve composition') but follows from cited statements: levelwise compact-description, a composite of lifts is a lift, and adic trace (4) does not depend on the lift. Accepted. Step 5: lem-weil-point-counts-finite (1), elementary, empty case included. Step 6: lem-pod (2) plus naturality of kappa give F j=j F_c, written out correctly; the identity compactification is a legitimate model, and admissibility is not tied to the model (def-trf-admissibility). Edge cases checked: empty, Spec F_q, Spec F_{q^2} (2 if 2|m, else 0), A^1 (q^m), P^1 (1+q^m), nonreduced and disconnected. Acyclic.
